name: io.github.forgemeshlabs/shopscout-mcp
description: Let your agent shop and compare: Shopify catalog search, offer ranking, shipping plans. $0.01/call.

environmentVariables.name: WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Private key of a dedicated low-balance Base wallet holding USDC; pays $0.01 per paid tool call via x402. Without it paid tools return the 402 challenge as data.

environmentVariables.name: SHOPSCOUT_MAX_PRICE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Per-call payment cap in USD (default 0.01).

environmentVariables.name: SHOPSCOUT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. API origin override (default https://shopscout.forgemesh.io); HTTPS, or HTTP on localhost for development.
